note: Target catalog: rows are data, not branches. The cc leg of the gate reads toolchain+flags+constraints from the c99 row. Missing target row = refuse that emission leg.

emission.subset: single-entry graph, main = bare closed-int expr (lit int | bin {+,-,*,/,%} | un neg, nested)
emission.shape: int main(void) { return <expr>; } — every node fully parenthesized

targets.notes: the observed runtime today is exactly this leg; a koru-spelled backend is a future row

targets.artifact: i386 object/asm via machine-checked C semantics (CompCert 3.5)
targets.via: c99 row output through CompCert ccomp -S/-c

compile.note: CompCert 3.5, i386 target; -c to .o also works, -o exe fails (image lacks i386 crt)

link_run.rebuild: docker run --name ccrun-build i386/debian:bookworm-slim sh -c 'apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends gcc libc6-dev' && docker commit ccrun-build isar/ccrun-i386-gcc:1 && docker rm ccrun-build
link_run.note: unverified link+run leg (binutils ld), kept separate from the verified compile

host_requirements: linux/i386 exec support (present on x86_64 docker)
toolchain.skip_when: either image absent -> skip, never fake with another compiler

constraints: requires emitted subset to stay inside CompCert-accepted C99
CompCert 3.5 emits i386 asm; link+run leg is unverified gcc/binutils
targets.notes: the machine-checked assembly leg: KProg -> C99 -> ccomp -S -> .s (verified) -> gcc i386 link+run (unverified witness of the artifact)
